name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-multilingual-intranet-switcher
title: Multilingual Intranet Switcher
shortDescription: A read-only, explicitly configured multilingual SharePoint intranet navigation and content switcher.
longDescription: This sample uses bounded local JSON configuration for locale labels, optional descriptions, and same-tenant SharePoint URLs. Browser locale detection only chooses the initial view; it does not translate content or call a translation API.
